text: Good evening, I am so sorry to be messaging at this hour. I'm sure you have far more urgent things to deal with and I nearly didn't send this at all. I'm looking after my granddaughter Lily tonight, she's 4, while her mum is away for work. Since about teatime she's been pulling at her left ear and telling me it hurts, and when I took her temperature just now it was 39.3. I gave her some of the children's paracetamol her mum left, the right amount for her age, I checked the box twice. The other thing, and I don't know if it's connected, is that she hasn't done a poo for three days now. She sits on the toilet and then gets cross and says she doesn't want to, and she's been quite grumpy about the whole business. I've been giving her water and some apple juice. I just don't want to get it wrong when she's in my care and her mum is so far away. Is it something that can wait for the doctor in the morning, or should I be taking her somewhere tonight? Again, I'm very sorry for bothering you.
